name: Totech Corporation
summary: Totech Corporation engages in the sale of air conditioning equipment in Japan. It is involved in the design, installation, maintenance, and repair of automatic control equipment. The company also offers the installation of electric devices, as well as linking control of various environmental systems and streamlining operations.
